svg.title: How yak works
svg.desc: A styled Button goes into the yak SWC plugin at build time. The plugin writes the styles to Button.yak.css and leaves a component that only sets the class name. The bundler then runs the CSS file through its CSS pipeline, PostCSS or Lightning CSS, into the app stylesheet.

g.text: A tagged template in a .tsx file.
The yak SWC plugin splits JS and CSS
A Rust plugin in your bundler writes the styles to their own CSS file.
PostCSS for webpack and Vite, Lightning CSS for Turbopack and Rsbuild.
